sheets.name: city_tiles
sheets.anchor: tile grid; opaque unless listed in 'overlay'
sheets.description: Night city tiles, frame order: sky_stars, void, sky_mid, sky_low, far_tower, far_block, far_step, far_fill, brick, brick_win_lit, brick_win_dark, brick_top, concrete, roof_l, roof_m, roof_r, ac_unit, chimney, antenna, tank_00, tank_01, tank_10, tank_11, tank_20, tank_21, ladder, sidewalk, curb, street, street_line, jamb_l, sign_p, jamb_r, lock_red, shutter, shutter_bottom, lock_green, open_ramp, lamp_top, lamp_pole, crate. Tiles in 'overlay' (roof props, water tanks, lamp post) keep pen 0 transparent and are drawn over the tile behind them with a masked blit; every other tile is a plain copy. Sky bands stack top-down sky_stars (or void) / sky_mid / sky_low, then a bg_far top (far_tower/far_block/far_step, any order) over far_fill; void for deep gaps. Roofs: roof_l / roof_m... / roof_r with brick/brick_win_* below; brick_top = low non-lip wall edge. Props sit on black one row above a roof. deco_tank is a 2x3 group (tank_RC, row-major). Street: sidewalk (walk row) over curb over street/street_line. Garage 4x5: row0 jamb_l sign_p lock_(red|green) jamb_r; closed rows1-3 shutter x2, row4 shutter_bottom x2; open rows1-3 void x2, row4 open_ramp x2. Lamp: lamp_top over lamp_pole on the sidewalk row.

sheets.name: city_drone
sheets.anchor: centred flyer; eye (laser origin) at x=13,y=11 when facing right
sheets.description: Illuminati pyramid drone: twin rotors, blinking red beacon, all-seeing eye. fly loops 4 frames at 80 ms; fire = eye flare + beam flash (spawn city_drone_shot at frame 1).

sheets.name: city_drone_shot
sheets.description: Red laser bolt, 2-frame shimmer, no outline (fills its frame like the bullet).

sheets.name: city_pickups
sheets.description: key: gold key with travelling glint (opens the garage). ammo: olive ammo box with two cartridges, glint.

sheets.name: city_car
sheets.anchor: tyres touch row 29, outline row 30 = road contact; faces right
sheets.description: Red muscle car for the escape cutscene: wheel spin, 1-row body bob, exhaust puff, headlight beam flicker, heroine's silhouette at the wheel.

notes: Humanoid agents in the mockups use the real city_agent sprite (levels/_chars/out/frames_city_agent.txt), drawn mirrored to face the heroine: fire frame 6 on the rooftop, walk frame 1 at street level. Rooftop gap in mockup_city is 3 tiles (within the 4-tile jump); right roof is 1 tile higher. Drone fire: flash frame 1 is 70 ms, then the bolt spawns from the eye row. The 41 tiles include `void` (plain black), used for the starless sky, deep gaps and the open garage interior.
